en.p: Two continuous random variables $X$ and $Y$ take values in the ranges $0\le X\le 6$ and $0\le Y\le 6$, and the probability density functions of $X$ and $Y$ are $f(x)$ and $g(x)$, respectively. The graph of the probability density function $f(x)$ of $X$ is as shown in the figure.

en.fig: See the original for the figure.

en.p: $\mathrm{P}(6k\le Y\le 15k)=\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
